top_signals.title: FTSE 100 Live: Stocks to jump; oil tips over $110 on lack of US-Iran progress
top_signals.summary: Welcome back to the City AM FTSE 100 liveblog. London’s blue-chip index is set to reverse some of its losses earlier in the week as investors weigh up the rising price of oil. top_signals.title: Citi's Luet on North Asia, Australia Outlook
top_signals.summary:
Marc Luet, Citi's Japan, Asia North and Australia Cluster Head, discusses his outlook for the bank's business in the region, and what he views are investment opportunities.
He speaks with Haidi Stroud Watts on the sidelines of the Citi ANZ Investment Conference on "Bloomberg: The Asia Trade".
 (Source: Bloomberg)
